    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches several test/functional/mempool_*.py files with mechanical one-line test updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR updates functional tests to drop dummy coinbase arguments but does not touch mempool logic, data structures, or acceptance policy."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes block generation template handling and coinbase output construction in src/rpc/mining.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Provides developer-facing tooling to simulate complex multi-recipient coinbase transactions in regtest blocks. While pool simulation developers benefit, developer-facing tooling sits below mainnet template validity and miner interface stability in mining priority."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/p2p_outbound_eviction.py only with a mechanical test adjustment.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Contains no changes to peer-to-peer protocols, transports, or message handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and alters the parameters, help, and client parsing for the generateblock RPC in src/rpc/mining.cpp and src/rpc/client.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Expands the generateblock RPC to support multiple coinbase outputs, custom payout amounts, and automatic mempool transaction inclusion. Reviewers noted external interest for simulating multi-payout mining pools (such as Ocean and Braidpool), addressing a test tooling gap without affecting mainnet RPC compatibility."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",

      "rationale": "Does not touch wallet logic or wallet RPCs; the test change is a mechanical follow-up."
    }
